task: FV2-040 — Responsive client update banner on desktop
summary: A user-provided Windows screenshot showed the long release summary wrapping into a very tall, underlined column and pushing the workspace below the fold. The Flutter update banner now clamps its summary to two lines with ellipsis and explicitly disables text decoration; full release details remain available in the existing details sheet. Package-version fallback defaults and all native platform build identities were synchronized with 1.0.35+68/r49 after release and Windows CI exposed version drift.
